other_conditions: Must be a citizen of India and a domiciled resident of Haryana.
Must have passed the qualifying examination from Punjab University, Kurukshetra University, or any other recognized examining body.
Must be enrolled in a recognized higher education course in Haryana or Chandigarh.
Must have obtained at least a Second Division in the qualifying examination.
For Rural Area Merit Scholarships, must have secured at least 40% marks in Matric/Higher Secondary/Pre-University examinations.
Must not be receiving any other merit‑based scholarship, except need‑based scholarships from specific welfare boards.
One Ph.D./M.Phil. scholarship is exclusively tenable at Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi.
Rural Area Merit Scholarships are limited to students whose parents permanently reside and earn their livelihood in rural areas.
benefits_summary: Scholarship amounts range from ₹150 per year for preparatory/secondary courses up to ₹900 per year for B.Ed., M.Phil., and Ph.D. programs, payable monthly for the duration of the course.
